fnol_text: My name is Sofia Achebe and I live at 571 Larkspur Street, Riverton, WY 82570. You can reach me on (555) 221-1789 or sofia.achebe@example.com. I was stopped at lights on 4 August 2025 when the car behind, driven by Lucia Osei, went into the back of mine. Rear bumper and boot are badly damaged. Policy MT-2024-00127. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. Please just tell me this is covered.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Achebe on (555) 221-1789 to acknowledge the claim. Sofia confirmed the loss date as 4 August 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Jordan Iyer gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Lucia Osei reports lower back strain and attended St. Brendan's Hospital. Sofia reports a sprained ankle.
